title: D-087 CAD-2: owner-openable sample files + plain-English AutoCAD opening checklist (closes the R004 owner-check gap, DB-057 a) and DXF writer STYLE/VPORT tables (DB-057 b) with a stdlib-allowlist import test (DB-057 f)
